purpose: Fresh controlled benchmark for equal-information hardware-search comparisons.

structural_space.representation: 23-bit boundary mask representing an ordered composition of 24 bits

controlled_comparison.rule: All algorithms receive exactly the same measured 8-candidate seed corpus and cannot observe another algorithm's new-query results.

open_ended_comparison.interpretation: Separate open-ended RTL-generation experiment; not a direct same-action-space ranking against structural algorithms.

reward.name: proxy_reward_v0
reward.note: Preserved unchanged from addpipe16. Pareto area/WNS results are tracked separately.

fmax_policy: Record but do not optimize or use in conclusions until validated.
